_comment: Front faces (+x, +y, -x, -y of the normalised asset frame) read on 9 Nov 2026 from the orientation-marker renders of session 3 job 1 (coloured spheres on the +x red, -x yellow, +y green, -y blue sides; the camera side of every image is therefore checkable and the render lag of session 2 is gone: the nearest marker is the camera's own side in all 88 images). 'clear' entries have an unambiguous front (door, seat, drawers, display); 'ambiguous' entries are symmetric or have no obvious front and carry an arbitrary but marker-referenced choice (a wrong choice turns furniture around, it does not change its class). The generator-footprint reconciliation may still turn a front by 90 degrees. dishwasher, kettle, tv, plant (not generator classes) and shower (excluded) are not read. Session 4 job 4 close-ups (dist factor 0.9) re-read sink, bed, desk, bookshelf/storage_shelf and workbench: sink front -y (door and handle; fixtures on the +y back), workbench front +y (drawers and shelves; pegboard back), bed long axis x with ends at +-x (foot end -x chosen, low confidence), desk and shelf symmetric (+x chosen).
